text:
Elena Ruiz: Heads up — CloudA marketplace rejected the PO (PO# 987654321). They say billing EIN doesn't match the vendor entity on file, so they won't apply the $150k partner credit. Launch scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need blocker workaround.
Samir Patel: Ugh. Do we have the vendor portal screenshot? Did procurement attach the wrong billing entity to the PO?
Elena Ruiz: I attached their portal rejection in the ticket. They point to "vendor_ein": "12-3456789" but our reseller mapping is 98-7654321.
Priya Narang: Can we create a second PO under the matching billing entity and reference both in the invoice? That was a workaround before.
James Li (Legal): @Priya that's possible but we need to check contract addendum. If the credit is conditional on a single PO/contract, splitting might void it. I'll confirm ASAP :eyes:
Marta Gomez: Tagging @Finance Ops — can you confirm if issuing a credit memo on our side and pushing net payment to partner would work?
Finance Ops: We can issue a manual credit, but marketplace reconciliation might still block recognition. Need the vendor portal acceptance screenshot and marketplace case #.
MarketplaceBot: New case created: CASE-2026-4794 referencing PO#987654321. Status: waiting_on_customer
Samir Patel: Attaching XML snippet from the PO we submitted:
```
<PO>
  <PONumber>987654321</PONumber>
  <BillingEntityEIN>98-7654321</BillingEntityEIN>
</PO>
```
Elena Ruiz: The partner insists the marketplace entity is CloudA LLC EIN 12-3456789. We can either update our billing entity on the PO (procurement lock) or get the partner to accept alternate entity.
Priya Narang: Quick plan: 1) @James confirm if split PO breaks credit 2) Marta confirm finance can issue credit memo 3) Samir get partner to sign acceptance email acknowledging alternate entity by EOD. If all green, we can flip before 05:00 PT.
James Li (Legal): I'll review the contract clause now. If we need a one-line addendum, I can draft it in 45 mins. If partner signs, marketplace usually accepts.
Marta Gomez: I'll stand by for the draft and finance will prep the credit memo template.
Elena Ruiz: Thanks everyone. This is high priority — partner webinar + press at 10am tomorrow. @Samir please ping me once partner email is in hand :pray:
Samir Patel: On it, sending follow-up to partner now.
